renderer.preset_policy: A preset is a performance and behaviour baseline, not a finished visual composition.
consumer_policy: Consumers own composition, contrast, masks, gradients, and readability.
Essential information must remain ordinary DOM content above decorative canvas layers.
Decorative field colour must not be used as evidence of live operational status.
New compositions require this catalogue and a real product need before source adoption.

compositions.evidence_contract: Route-local browser evidence must assert one canvas, non-zero dimensions, visible pixels, no overflow, and no AtlasField console errors.

validation_requirements: Catalogue names, routes, selectors, presets, host classes, canvas class, seeds, density, domain breaks, domain styles, and light parameters must remain deterministic.
Composition routes must be unique, canonical absolute paths ending in a slash, and sorted by composition name.
All current catalogue entries must use the ambient preset and pointer disabled unless a later catalogue revision records a real product need.
A consumer source change that adds, removes, renames, or remaps a composition must update this catalogue and its fingerprint in the same review.
Browser evidence for each routed consumer must prove one decorative canvas, visible pixels, reduced-motion behaviour, no horizontal overflow, and no AtlasField console or page errors.
